lines.say: Elizabeth Holmes reported to federal prison on May thirtieth, two thousand twenty-three.
lines.show: Elizabeth Holmes reported to federal prison on May 30, 2023.

lines.say: In February two thousand twenty-five, the Ninth Circuit affirmed her conviction. The vision she sold, it wrote, was nothing more than a mirage.
lines.show: In February 2025, the Ninth Circuit affirmed her conviction. The vision she sold, it wrote, was "nothing more than a mirage."

lines.say: In March two thousand twenty-six, her sentence was cut from one hundred thirty-five to one hundred twenty-three months.
lines.show: In March 2026, her sentence was cut from 135 to 123 months.

lines.say: She has asked President Trump to commute her sentence. According to Forbes, as of late September the request was listed as pending.
The same report says she has been approved for a halfway house in August two thousand twenty-seven, with release scheduled for February two thousand thirty.
lines.show: The same report says she has been approved for a halfway house in August 2027, with release scheduled for February 2030.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
